GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well settled down midfield 2wide 5 lengths straightened up on the improve 3l kept coming finished just too well , visors off # had good run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported instructed to ride the gelding along from the start, as has been slow to muster speed in recent starts and after riding along was able to maintain mid-field position. Trainer advised gelding had been given a freshen up, had jumped-out well and had engaged a senior rider in order to have the gelding maintain a closer position.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped Just Ok from the Inside . Quickly Drifted Back Settled Down Clear last, 10 Lengths @ 700m. Same Position Straightening Up . Just Held Ground # never came into it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. RR Failed to travel during the race and became detached from the remainder of the field in the middle stages, despite her efforts. Added, however, that once balanced in the straight she was satisfied with her mount's finishing effort.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Not Bustled Drifted Back towards rear With Cover 8l Straightened Up widest 6l battled on one pace to the line # back/even to line

Jumped Ok Showed no early dash lost contact with field Settled Down tailed off rear 10L rail home turn 7.5l railed hard made good grd 50m crowded. r-instr settled 2nd half, closer to rail Felt at top 1000m # made vgood ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Lost contact with the bulk of the field through the middle stages.  Approaching the 50m was eased when briefly crowded to the inside of runners. When questioned RR - that she had been instructed to settle in the second half of the field and to maintain a position close to the rail where the stable felt the going was superior. They added the gelding failed to show early speed and settled towards the rear. They added that gelding was racing at its top passing 1000m where it began to lose contact with the bulk of the field (Continue in Stewards Report)

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Near the 150m improved onto heels before being shifted out abruptly a number of horses to continue to improve.
